paragraphs: MicroVote General Corporation, based in Indianapolis, IN, sells election equipment and support. The company describes itself as a manufacturer of nationally certified voting systems.

The products page states that the company provides voting equipment sales and machine servicing for different counties, and that it can set up and maintain systems as well as offer training on how to use the machines. The MicroVote Infinity Voting Panel (VP-1) is a Direct Recording Electronic (DRE) voting device for use in governmental and private elections. A Voter Verifiable Paper Audit Trail (VVPAT) printer can be combined with that panel as an add-on feature to an existing system. An All-In-One Voting Station is listed as accommodating both a voting panel and a printer in a single unit, ready to go on Election Day.
The company also distributes the KNOWiNK Electronic Poll Pad, an electronic poll book. The products page says the Poll Pad is now in over 500 jurisdictions across the country.

quote.text: MicroVote General Corporation provides voting equipment sales and machine servicing for different counties.
